title_en: Getting to Know Shapes: The Monster Tree
source_file: 认识平面图形：妖怪树（5-8岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 数学来了！
认识三角形、圆形、正方形、长方形等
认识平面图形
妖怪村
钟林姣 文 陈楠 绘
金盾出版社

[P2] 胖胖熊喜欢听熊爸爸讲故事，熊爸爸却只会讲妖怪村的故事。
这个故事，熊爸爸讲一万遍都不厌倦，胖胖熊听一万遍也不厌倦。
胖胖熊都能把妖怪村的妖怪名字倒背如流了：房子妖怪、树妖怪、
南瓜妖怪、勺子妖怪、平底锅妖怪……

“妖怪村就在一座很圆很圆的大石头山后面，从长方形的入口
进去，就能看到它了。”熊爸爸本来有很多妖怪照片，可全都不见了。
真可惜，这恐怕是熊爸爸这辈子最大的遗憾了。
那座很圆很圆的石头山，在熊熊王国的哪个地方？熊爸爸可没
有告诉胖胖熊。

[P3] 现在，胖胖熊要独自生活了。
熊妈妈再三叮咛要找个温暖的树洞，熊爸爸则是给了他一个正方形的小盒子。
“等你不想待在温暖树洞里的时候再打开。”
胖胖熊把盒子放进长方形的旅行箱里。为了压住自己的好奇心，他在盒子上面层层叠叠放了好多衣服。
胖胖熊没有去找温暖的树洞，他拉着长方形的旅行箱，脖子上还挂着一架相机，要去寻找熊爸爸说的妖怪村。
要是他有张地图就好了。

[P4] 对了，熊爸爸给的正方形小盒子，里面究竟放了什么？他打开旅行箱，把层层叠叠的衣服拿开——原来小盒子里面装的是一张被折叠了好几次的纸张。
胖胖熊打开又打开，打开又打开——
天哪，这竟然是去妖怪村的地图！
胖胖熊已经迫不及待地想要按照地图上的指示出发了。

胖胖熊先经过了一个屋顶全都是三角形的村庄，接着来到了一条大河边。河上没有桥，也没有船，只有各种形状的石墩。
怎么才能过河呢？不着急，一条红鲤鱼告诉他，顺着河流往上走，找到长方形石墩，踩着它们就能过河。

[P5] 河对面是一座座大山。
这些大山有长方形的、圆形的，还有正方形和三角形的。
胖胖熊找到圆圆的石头山和长方形入口。从入口进去，走过长长的隧道，他看到了一块三角形的村碑，碑面上写着——妖怪村！
哇哇哇，他终于来到妖怪村啦！

[P6] 圆圆的太阳挂在天空上，妖怪村里静悄悄的。
太好了，妖怪们都在午睡。
正方形的草本妖怪在两棵树中间打着呼噜，
口水顺着嘴角往下流。
树底下，长方形凳子妖怪显得有些疲惫，他
的脸不知道被谁涂成了大花脸。
圆圆的水井边，躺着水桶妖怪，他的一只眼
睛睁着，一只眼睛闭着，真逗！
哎哟，勺子妖怪的脚插进了南瓜妖怪的嘴里。不过，妖怪村的村
碑真多，只要胖胖熊一回头就能看到。

[P7] 熊熊日报
妖怪村
咔嚓，咔嚓，咔嚓——
胖胖熊拍了好多照片，要是
他把这些照片发给《熊熊日报》，
肯定能引起轰动。
当然，拍摄照片
的过程中，他也出现
了一些意外。比如，不
小心摔了个嘴啃泥，
意外掉进了染缸，一
只大鸟妖怪在他的头
上拉了一坨便便。
但是，比起他相机
里的妖怪照片，这些意
外都不算什么。

[P8] “站住！”
哎呀呀，胖胖熊被三角形村碑挡住了去路。天哪，他的脖子上也挂着相机。
唉，熊爸爸讲故事的时候并没说村碑也是妖怪呀！

趁妖怪们没有醒，
赶快离开吧。

[P9] 这么说，他摔了个嘴啃泥、摔进染缸、头上有坨鸟粪的镜头，村碑妖怪都拍下来了。
“我们做个交换，你把拍了我们妖怪村照片的相机给我，我把拍了你照片的相机给你。如果你不愿意，我会把你的照片寄给《熊熊日报》……”
不要！不要！
胖胖熊把相机给了村碑妖怪，村碑妖怪也把相机给了胖胖熊。
“以前也来了只拍照的熊，你俩长得很像。”
原来熊爸爸的妖怪照片就是这么弄丢的！
胖胖熊把那张妖怪村的地图折了又折，折了又折，直到折成一个小小的纸团。他把纸团放进正方形的小盒子里，也许以后，他会把它送给自己的孩子。

[P10] 拼拼看！
胖胖熊离开妖怪村的时候，村碑妖怪要考一考他，
让他用正方形、长方形、三角形和圆形拼一幅画，你
能用贴纸帮助胖胖熊把画拼出来吗？

妖怪村里有各种图形妖怪，
请把贴纸贴到相应的地方。
full_text_en:
[P1] Math is here!
Learn triangles, circles, squares, rectangles, etc.
Recognizing Plane Shapes
Monster Village
Written by Zhong Linjiao, Illustrated by Chen Nan
Jin Dun Publishing House

[P2] Pang Pang Bear loves listening to Bear Dad tell stories, but Bear Dad only ever tells stories about Monster Village.
This story, Bear Dad can tell a million times without getting tired, and Pang Pang Bear can listen a million times without getting tired.
Pang Pang Bear can even recite the names of the monsters in Monster Village backwards: House Monster, Tree Monster,
Pumpkin Monster, Spoon Monster, Frying Pan Monster……

"Monster Village is behind a big, round, round stone mountain. You enter through a rectangular doorway,
and then you can see it." Bear Dad used to have many photos of the monsters, but they're all gone now.
What a pity—this is probably Bear Dad's biggest regret in life.
That big, round, round stone mountain—where in Bear Bear Kingdom is it? Bear Dad never
 told Pang Pang Bear.

[P3] Now, Fat Bear is going to live on his own.
Bear Mom kept reminding him to find a warm tree hollow, while Bear Dad gave him a small square box.
"Open it when you don't want to stay in the warm tree hollow anymore."
Fat Bear put the box into a rectangular suitcase. To suppress his curiosity, he piled many clothes on top of the box.
Fat Bear didn't go to find a warm tree hollow. He pulled his rectangular suitcase, with a camera hanging around his neck, heading out to find the monster village his dad talked about.
If only he had a map.

[P4] What could be inside the square little box given by Bear Dad? He opened his suitcase, pulled out the layers of clothes—inside the small box was a piece of paper folded many times.
Bear Cub opened it, then opened it again, and again—
Wow, it's actually a map to the Monster Village!
Bear Cub couldn't wait to set off following the map's instructions.

Bear Cub first passed through a village with triangular roofs, then arrived at a big river. There were no bridges or boats on the river, only stone stepping stones of various shapes.
How could he cross the river? Don't worry, a red carp told him, follow the river upstream, find the rectangular stepping stones, and step on them to cross.

[P5] On the other side of the river are mountains.
These mountains are rectangular, circular, square, and triangular.
Bao Bao Bear found the round stone mountain and the rectangular entrance. He went in, walked through a long tunnel, and saw a triangular village sign with the words —— Monster Village!
Wow wow wow, he finally arrived at Monster Village!

[P6] A round sun hangs in the sky, and the monster village is quiet.
Great, the monsters are all napping.
The square grass monster is snoring between two trees,
with drool dripping from his mouth.
Under the tree, the rectangular stool monster looks tired; his
face has been painted into a big mess.
By the round well, the bucket monster is lying down, one eye
open and one eye closed—how funny!
Oops, the spoon monster's foot is stuck in the pumpkin monster's mouth. But, there are so many village
signs in the monster village; as long as Fat Bear turns around, he can see them.

[P7] Bear Bear Daily
Monster Village
Click, click, click—
Fat Bear took many photos. If he sent these photos to the 'Bear Bear Daily',
they would surely cause a sensation.
Of course, during the photo-taking process,
he encountered some unexpected incidents. For example,
he accidentally fell face-first into the mud,
and unexpectedly fell into a dye vat, where
a big bird monster pooped on his head.
But compared to the monster photos in his camera,
these incidents were nothing.

[P8] "Stop!"
Oh no, Fat Bear is blocked by the triangular village marker. Goodness, he's also wearing a camera around his neck.
Hmm, Dad Bear didn't mention the village marker was a monster when he told the story!

While the monsters are still asleep,
let's leave quickly.

[P9] So, he fell face-first, fell into the dye vat, and had a bird dropping on his head—all of which the village stone monster photographed.
"Let's make a trade. You give me the camera with the photos of our monster village, and I'll give you the camera with your photos. If you don't agree, I'll send your photos to the 'Bear Bear Daily'..."
No! No!
Bubu Bear gave his camera to the village stone monster, and the stone monster gave his camera to Bubu Bear.
"A bear who came here to take photos before looked just like you."
So that's how Dad Bear's monster photos got lost!
Bubu Bear folded the map of Monster Village again and again, until it became a tiny paper ball. He put the paper ball into a small square box, perhaps one day he'll give it to his own child.

[P10] Let's try it!
When Fat Bear was leaving Monster Village, the village stone monster wanted to test him.
He asked Fat Bear to create a picture using squares, rectangles, triangles, and circles.
Can you help Fat Bear complete the picture with stickers?

There are various shape monsters in Monster Village.
Please stick the stickers in the correct places.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本《妖怪村》的封面，主题为“认识平面图形”，介绍了通过故事学习三角形、圆形、正方形、长方形等基本图形，画面中有拟人化的三角形、南瓜和水桶。
[P2] 胖胖熊和熊爸爸在家中，熊爸爸讲述妖怪村的故事，胖胖熊听得入迷。画面右侧展示了妖怪村的景象，包括圆形的石头山、长方形的入口和各种拟人化的妖怪，如南瓜、平底锅等。
[P3] 胖胖熊准备独自生活，父母为他准备了物品并叮嘱他。他没有去找温暖的树洞，而是带着旅行箱和相机出发去寻找妖怪村，希望能有地图指引。
[P4] 胖胖熊打开熊爸爸给的正方形小盒子，发现里面是一张去妖怪村的地图，他迫不及待地出发。他经过三角形屋顶的村庄，来到河边，在红鲤鱼的指引下，准备踩着长方形石墩过河。
[P5] 胖胖熊根据地图指引，穿过隧道，来到妖怪村入口，看到三角形的村碑，兴奋地抵达目的地。
[P6] 胖胖熊抵达妖怪村，发现村中妖怪们正在午睡，场景中充满了各种拟人化的平面图形妖怪，如正方形草本妖怪、长方形凳子妖怪、水桶妖怪和南瓜妖怪，画面生动展现了妖怪村的宁静与趣味。
[P7] 胖胖熊在妖怪村拍摄了许多照片，虽然途中遭遇了摔跤、掉进染缸和被鸟粪砸中等意外，但他认为这些都不算什么，因为他拍到了珍贵的妖怪照片。
[P8] 胖胖熊抵达妖怪村，被会说话的三角形村碑拦住，发现村碑也是妖怪，他意识到妖怪们正在午睡，决定趁机悄悄离开。
[P9] 胖胖熊与妖怪村的村碑妖怪交换相机，得知自己父亲的照片也是这样丢失的。他将妖怪村的地图折成纸团，放进小盒子里，准备带回家。
[P10] 胖胖熊离开妖怪村时，村碑妖怪让他用正方形、长方形、三角形和圆形拼画，页面设计为互动游戏，邀请读者用贴纸完成图画。
